gaps.detail: Review target Joomla core, PHP, database, mail, ClamAV, ffprobe and remote providers against current authoritative advisories; record patch levels and decisions per candidate. First-party package scan cannot close this.
Inspect host-specific environment, secret stores, deployment logs and rotations without copying secrets into GitHub; historical source pattern scan is not comprehensive.
Independent dynamic negative-path review against final deployed candidate and roles; SEC-P5 owns the final go/no-go and manual acceptance.

SECDEV-07/02 first-party Semgrep CE/Ruff/secret/package gates were integrated in PR #858 (CI 4/4, 44909562794), but local rules are not a proof of comprehensive security coverage: record expanded SAST review, remediation of 1475 historical Python Ruff violations (new issues blocked), platform/component SCA and any accepted false positives per final release candidate. These checks remain explicit release review constraints and do not invalidate implemented software controls.
